reason: The analyst restricted the sample to the north region without justification and also trimmed the outcome. That halves the power (SE 0.35 against 0.24), and the report calls the result 'no effect' when the estimate is just imprecise. On the full sample with all pre-period controls the effect is positive and significant (0.69, SE 0.24, p=0.004). The region interaction terms are not significant, so there is no evidence that north differs, and the north-only estimate of 0.34 is consistent with the full-sample effect.
